data.title: 烧盐柠檬 · 碧海热浪里的沙排飞身重扣
data.description: 三河湾蔚蓝海岸的洁白沙滩排球网前，浪花飞溅。身穿亮黄运动比基尼的柠檬高高跃起凌空暴扣，健硕小麦色身躯在烈日下划出充满力量感的流线，阳光明澈耀眼。
data.location: sun-drenched ocean beach volleyball court with crashing turquoise waves in background
data.action: leaping dynamically high above volleyball net, arm drawn back to spike ball with ferocious athletic force, joyful competitive yell
data.lighting: 热带烈阳直射与沙滩白光耀斑
data.promptProse: Lemon leaps high above the beach volleyball net in her citrus yellow bikini, spiking the ball with vibrant athletic energy beneath the blazing summer sun.
data.animaCaption: Sea spray and sand glisten in the bright sunlight as she spikes the volleyball mid-air.
